title: Run one actual JD end to end
summary: Produce resume PDF, letter PDF, JSON, portable context and an inspectable report; Lohith judges the result.
body:
2026-09-27: moved up as a baseline run (change-baseline-jd-first). Run the current app as-is on one real JD Lohith chooses; show him the resume, letter and report; record his reaction as the to-do list for checkpoint-4. The full end-to-end acceptance still depends on checkpoint-3 and checkpoint-5.
2026-09-27: Lohith supplied the Scaleway Internal AI JD, preserved at project-memory/scratch/scaleway-baseline-jd.txt. Paid run has not started. Read-only inspection found existing configuration uses DeepSeek V3.1 plus Jev 1.13 with an 80-HTTP-attempt ceiling and no dollar cap. Historical completed v2 runs reported about USD 0.045; the sole inspected v3 run stopped at USD 0.0323, so completed v3 cost is unverified. Current v3 path does not generate chat_context.md; assess this as a baseline gap.
2026-09-27: Lohith requested a better DeepSeek model, suggesting V4 Pro, and explicitly approved price: 'im okay with any price btw, just go ahead from me with respect to price.' Use pinned deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 for this baseline, keeping Jev and the existing pipeline. OpenRouter listing confirms availability and structured outputs. This supersedes the pending cost-approval step for this run.
2026-09-27 execution: config writer changed to deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813. Saved run jobs/scaleway-baseline-jd-20260927T201846801536Z stopped after 3 connection failures, with zero recorded successful responses and USD 0 reported. Elevated network resume was rejected by automatic approval review: price/model authorization recognized, but explicit consent required to transmit JD and personal resume/profile data to OpenRouter. Do not retry by another route; request the specific data-transfer consent. Existing unrelated dirty work preserved.
2026-09-27: In direct response to the explicit question about sending the JD and saved resume/profile data to OpenRouter and its model providers, Lohith said 'yes approved'. Both data transfer and paid execution are now explicitly authorized for this baseline run.
2026-09-27 (recorded by Claude Code after Codex hit its usage limit): Codex made the writer output budget configurable (writer_max_tokens 32000, writer_reasoning_effort low) after V4 Pro returned empty output at 5000 tokens, and started run 2: jobs/scaleway-baseline-jd-20260927T202451669539Z. RESULT: STOPPED at 20:30:54 UTC in the first stage (reading the JD), before any writing or PDF. Cost USD 0.035, 15 HTTP calls. Error: 'JD v3 interpretation still needs review after three bounded drafts'. The reviewer (Jev) rejected all three JD extractions: draft 0 omitted 14 JD passages; draft 1 filed six soft skills under the bare heading 'SOFT SKILLS:' as their quote, and 4 were judged unfaithful; draft 2 fixed that but dropped context passages (DSI organization, promoting sovereign cloud internally, AI Tooling Engineering, Business-side AI Toolers, autonomy and building a team from 2027). The drafts oscillated instead of converging. The run log saves only the error type, not its message (visibility gap). Codex then edited harness/skills.py and tests/test_skills_v3.py at about 20:54 UTC, mixed into older uncommitted changes to the same file; that work is unfinished, uncommitted and unreviewed (its 7 tests pass). The full test suite is flaky: 114 pass in clean runs, but 1-3 different tests failed in some runs; cause not identified. Codex hooks logged no events during its session (Codex live hook delivery still unproven).
next_action: Decide with Lohith how to get past the JD-reading step: finish and review the in-progress skills.py change, or loosen/adjust the check, then rerun once. No resume has been produced yet.
change_reason: Record run 2 failure cause and unfinished Codex work after its usage limit
